what: On hover, a red panel passes once in a straight .5s line from outside the button’s left (-110%) to outside its right (110%), and meanwhile the text flips to white at 10~20% and returns to dark ink from 58%. The arrow circle swaps red and white at 38~44% — a ”sweeping glint” button. On release the panel returns to place without easing

options.--fx-ease: Curve the panel travels along (via style), default linear
options.look: keep: Text color stays the same and only the panel sweeps past (white-outline button on a dark stage)
options.[data-fx-part=icon]: (if present) arrow circle — filled with the panel color, and at 38~44% the panel color and text color swap. The inner svg uses fill="currentColor"

use: Learn more · White-outline button: data-fx-flash-sweep-hover="look: keep" style="--fx-ink: var(--kf-contrast-ink)"
note: The panel is painted on the element’s own ::before (z-index -1, isolation) — for a button that uses ::before elsewhere, attach it to an inner span. The original moved two layers, ::before and ::after, but they share the same position and values, so one layer is equivalent. When the panel color and background are swapped, as in the header ENTRY (white panel over a red button · red text), pass --fx-fill · --fx-ink · --fx-on reversed

from.where: shared.css .ck-btn (outlined button — red panel .5s linear · text 10~20% · 58% · circle 38~44%) · .ck-entry (header ENTRY — white panel over the red button, red text) — original .cBtnMain:hover:before · .lHeader__entry:hover:after
